purpose: v9 operational sealed BLIND runtime audit with verified pre-submission staging and exact absolute CWD/argv bindings.

inputs.job_spec_sha_rule: The future independent PASS review binds the actual final-job SHA-256; this immutable draft contains no circular final-job digest.

post_run_scheduler_audit.terminal_claim_rule: Only a separately captured scheduler-audit artifact may claim RELEASED_VERIFIED.

receipt_schema.runtime_label_rule: UNIQUE requires exactly one matched attempt with a nonempty measured wall_s. Timeout/nonzero attempts with wall_s remain chargeable; every no-wall attempt is MISSING_RUNTIME.

lifecycle.draft_rule: DRAFT_NO_EXECUTION is not submit-able and contains no final digest or job id.
lifecycle.finalization_rule: The external manifest contains only immutable pre-submission implementation and input-control files, avoiding a receipt self-digest cycle. Final artifacts are separately digest-linked. Both bjobs cwd and bjobs -al Specified CWD must equal the resolved bundle root; the independent review is committed before release so the runner sees a clean checkout.
